title: Backprop Gradient Shape
prompt:
In a linear layer Y = X·W with X of shape [18×24] and W of shape [24×59], the weight gradient is dL/dW = Xᵀ·(dL/dY).

What is its shape? Enter `rows cols`.
hint: dL/dW has the same shape as W
recap: In Y = X·W, backprop gives dL/dW = Xᵀ·(dL/dY), which has the same shape as W. Gradients always match the shape of what they differentiate.
